anthelmintic.definitionKo: 몸속의 기생충을 없애는 데 쓰는 약.
anthelmintic.englishDescription: Medicine used for eliminating worms inside the body.

celebration.definitionKo: 남의 좋은 일에 대해 기쁜 마음으로 인사함. 또는 그런 인사.
celebration.englishDescription: An act of greeting someone with pleasure, commenting on his/her happy occasion, achievement, etc., or such a greeting.
A ceremony or event to celebrate an occasion.
A party held to celebrate a happy event.
Celebrating a happy and joyful occasion.

eclecticism.definitionKo: 서로 다른 둘 이상의 입장에서 좋은 점을 취하여 서로 잘 어울리도록 알맞게 조절하는 태도.
eclecticism.englishDescription: The attitude of taking positive elements from two or more perspectives and bringing them into a harmonious state.

eros.englishDescription: The god of love appearing in a Greek mythology.

executive.definitionKo: 기관이나 조직에서 핵심적인 위치에 있는 사람.
executive.englishDescription: A person who holds a key position in an institution or organization.
A person who holds an important position.
A person who manages and operates a business or company.

executive.definitionKo: 기업이나 사업을 관리하고 운영하는 사람이나 기관.
executive.englishDescription: A person or organization that manages and operates a business or company.

left-hander.definitionKo: 오른손보다 왼손을 더 많이 쓰거나 잘 쓰는 사람.
left-hander.englishDescription: A person who uses his/her left hand more often or skillfully than the right one.

naengchae.definitionKo: 전복, 해삼, 닭고기 등에 오이, 배추 등의 채소를 잘게 썰어 넣고 차갑게 만들어 먹는 음식.
naengchae.englishDescription: Chilled salad, a dish made by mixing sliced vegetables such as cucumber, cabbage, etc., with abalone, sea cucumber, chicken, etc., and seasoning the mixture.

plead.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 일의 형편을 말하고 도와줄 것을 간절하게 부탁하다.
plead.englishDescription: To explain one's situation to another person and earnestly ask for his/her help.

plead.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 일의 형편을 말하고 도와줄 것을 부탁하다.
plead.englishDescription: To explain the situation of something to someone and ask for his/her help.
To make a request to someone while explaining one's own situation.

plead.definitionKo: 요청이나 소원을 들어 달라고 간절히 부탁하다.
plead.englishDescription: To earnestly request to meet a person's demands or to be granted.
To explain one's pitiful and difficult situation to someone and ask for help or a favor.
To explain one's pitiful and difficult situation to someone and ask for help or a favor.

plead.definitionKo: 자신의 어렵거나 억울한 사정을 다른 사람에게 알려 도움을 청하다.
plead.englishDescription: To ask another for help by describing one's situation to someone such as unfair treatment, difficulties, etc.

psychiatry.definitionKo: 정신 질환을 앓고 있는 사람을 진단하고 치료하는 의학 분야. 또는 그 분야의 병원.
psychiatry.englishDescription: A field of medical science that diagnoses and treats those who suffer from mental disorders, or the department of the hospital that is in charge of the field.

warmer.definitionKo: 음식물 등을 따뜻하게 보관하는 상자 모양의 기계.
warmer.englishDescription: A box-shaped device for keeping food, etc., warm.
